title: Hey, I'm Supposed to be Free Range
author: Anonymous
description:
Crossing the road just got a lot tougher. All these damn traffic cones. You're amazed ...
[--blurb from The Z-Files Catalogue]

Written by "Opal O'Donnell", it was revealed years later this game was really written by Adam Cadre so he could use Opal's name as a pseudonym for when he released "Photopia".
